findings.title: N+1 query loading sale lines
findings.evidence: foreach (var s in sales) s.Lines = _context.SaleDetails.Where(d => d.SaleId == s.Id).ToList();
findings.impact: Invoice listing issues one query per sale.
findings.remediation: Use Include(s => s.Lines) or a projection.

findings.title: Tracking queries used for read-only lists
findings.impact: Change tracker overhead on every list call.

findings.title: N+1 query loading purchase lines
findings.evidence: foreach (var p in purchases) p.Lines = _context.PurchaseDetails.Where(d => d.PurchaseId == p.Id).ToList();
findings.impact: Bill listing for a large supplier issues thousands of queries and times out.
findings.remediation: Use Include(p => p.Lines) or a projection.
